Hello,

Thanks for following up, and sorry this hasn't landed yet. I've checked and can confirm the refund for the late fee is going ahead — since the equipment wasn't actually returned late (the depot wasn't staffed to receive it at the agreed time), that charge shouldn't have been applied in the first place, and we're correcting it. It can take a few business days to show on your account; if it still hasn't appeared shortly, let us know and we'll chase it directly with our finance team.

Sorry again for the delay and the inconvenience.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
